mainEntity.name: What is AI agent development?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI agent development is the process of building autonomous software systems that can perceive their environment, reason about goals, use tools (APIs, databases, browsers), and execute multi-step tasks with minimal human supervision. Unlike traditional chatbots that follow rigid scripts, AI agents adapt their behaviour based on context and feedback to achieve business outcomes.

mainEntity.name: How much does it cost to build an AI agent in India?

acceptedAnswer.text: AI agent development cost in India ranges from ₹40,000 for a single-task chatbot, ₹1,80,000 to ₹6,00,000 for a production-grade integrated agent, and ₹8,00,000+ for enterprise multi-agent systems. Final pricing depends on integrations, model choice, expected traffic, and accuracy requirements. We provide fixed INR quotes with GST invoice within 24 hours of your enquiry.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to develop an AI agent?

acceptedAnswer.text: A simple RAG chatbot or workflow agent takes 2 to 4 weeks. A production agent with CRM and helpdesk integrations takes 5 to 10 weeks. Enterprise multi-agent systems take 12 to 20 weeks. We always ship a working prototype in the first 7 days so you can validate the use case before full investment.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between a chatbot and an AI agent?

acceptedAnswer.text: A traditional chatbot follows pre-defined decision trees and intents. An AI agent uses a large language model to reason about its goal, decide which tools to call (search, database, API, calculator), execute multi-step plans, and self-correct when something fails. Agents are non-deterministic, tool-using, and goal-oriented, while chatbots are scripted and reactive.

mainEntity.name: Which AI models do you use?

acceptedAnswer.text: We are model-agnostic. We use OpenAI GPT-5 for general reasoning and tool use, Anthropic Claude Sonnet 4.6 for long-context document analysis and coding, Google Gemini 2.5 for multimodal tasks, and open-source Llama or Mistral models when data privacy or cost requires on-premise deployment. We pick the right model per task, not per fashion.

mainEntity.name: Can you build voice agents that speak Hindi and Indian languages?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We build voice agents in Hindi, English, Gujarati, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi and Bengali using ElevenLabs, Sarvam AI, and OpenAI's voice models. They handle inbound and outbound calls over Twilio or Exotel, integrate with your CRM, and are tuned for Indian accents and code-mixed conversation.

mainEntity.name: What integrations can the AI agent connect to?

acceptedAnswer.text: Our agents integrate with HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce, Freshdesk, Zendesk, Intercom, Slack, Microsoft Teams, Google Workspace, Notion, Airtable, WhatsApp Business API, Razorpay, Shopify, WooCommerce, Odoo, Tally, custom databases (Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB), and any REST or GraphQL API.

mainEntity.name: How do you ensure the AI agent is accurate and safe?

acceptedAnswer.text: We build evaluation datasets specific to your use case, run automated evals before every deployment, add guardrails using libraries like Guardrails AI or NeMo Guardrails, implement human-in-the-loop for high-stakes decisions, log every agent action for audit, and monitor token costs and latency in production. Quality is engineered, not hoped for.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer ongoing support and improvements?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. After launch, we offer monthly retainers starting at ₹35,000 per month for prompt tuning, eval improvements, new tool integration, edge-case handling and model upgrades. Most clients stay on retainer because AI agents need continuous improvement as your business and the underlying models evolve.

mainEntity.name: Can the AI agent be deployed on our own cloud or on-premise?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We deploy on AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, Vercel, or your own VPC. For sensitive workloads we deploy fully on-premise using open-source models like Llama 3.3 or Mistral, with no data ever leaving your infrastructure. We also handle DPDP, SOC 2 and ISO 27001 compliance requirements.

acceptedAnswer.text: A chatbot follows a fixed script. An AI agent picks its own next action at runtime - choosing which tool to call, when to escalate, and when to stop. Agents can read context, query APIs, write to your database, and chain multiple steps without a hardcoded flow.

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to deploy a production-grade AI agent?

mainEntity.name: What workflows are best suited for AI agents in 2026?

acceptedAnswer.text: High-volume, repetitive, rule-based work where escalation is acceptable: lead qualification, Tier-1 support, invoice reconciliation, returns processing, appointment scheduling, and outbound voice follow-ups.

mainEntity.name: Do AI agents replace humans?

acceptedAnswer.text: No - they replace the boring 80%. Humans focus on the high-judgement 20% (edge cases, client relationships, strategy). Most teams report higher headcount post-AI, just doing more valuable work.

mainEntity.name: How long does App Store rejection appeal take?

acceptedAnswer.text: If you reply in Resolution Center, Apple typically responds within 24-48 hours. If you escalate to App Review Board, expect 5-10 business days. In our experience, simply fixing the issue and resubmitting is faster than appealing in 90% of cases.

mainEntity.name: Can my app be permanently banned from the App Store?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, for repeated guideline violations, fraud, or developer-account-level issues (fake reviews, multiple accounts, scams). Single-app rejections almost always reach approval after fixes. Developer-account bans are rare and usually involve egregious policy violations.

mainEntity.name: Is Sign in with Apple really required?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes - if you offer ANY third-party social sign-in (Google, Facebook, Twitter, LinkedIn), you must also offer Sign in with Apple as an equivalent option. The exception: if you only offer email/password or a corporate SSO (Okta, Azure AD), Sign in with Apple is not required.

mainEntity.name: Why does Apple reject some apps but not similar ones?

acceptedAnswer.text: Two reasons. (1) Apple Review is partly human - different reviewers interpret edge cases differently. (2) Established apps often get grandfathered into policies that block new apps. The fix isn’t to argue “but App X does this” - it’s to comply with the current guideline.

mainEntity.name: Is ASO worth doing for a small app?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, especially for small apps. ASO is free compared to paid acquisition (₹50-300 per install on Indian Apple Search Ads, ₹15-80 on Play Store). For an app with even 1,000 organic installs/month, 30% lift from ASO = 300 extra installs/month at zero cost.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between ASO and mobile SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: ASO targets the App Store and Play Store algorithms - keywords, screenshots, conversion. Mobile SEO is regular web SEO optimised for mobile devices, targeting Google search rather than the app stores. Both matter: your landing page does SEO, your store page does ASO.

mainEntity.name: Can I do ASO myself or do I need an agency?

acceptedAnswer.text: You can absolutely DIY the basics: keyword research, name/subtitle optimization, decent screenshots. That gets you 60-70% of the value. Agencies justify their fees on: data tools, A/B testing methodology, regular iteration discipline, and competitor monitoring. For apps under 10K MAU, DIY is fine. Beyond that, an agency typically pays for itself.

acceptedAnswer.text: Only if it’s genuinely an MVP (5-8 screens, single platform, basic auth, no payments, no chat, pre-built UI components). Anyone promising a feature-rich app in 4 weeks is either lying or planning to deliver low quality. Real MVPs need 6-10 weeks; standard apps need 12-16.

mainEntity.name: Whats the fastest part of an app project to speed up?

acceptedAnswer.text: Backend - use a BaaS like Supabase or Firebase and you save 2-4 weeks. Slowest to speed up: design approval cycles (politics) and App Store review (Apple’s schedule, not yours). Lock scope, single decision-maker, and use pre-built components are the highest-leverage time savers.

mainEntity.name: Should I build both iOS and Android together or one at a time?

acceptedAnswer.text: Together if you’re using cross-platform (Flutter or React Native) - it’s the same effort. One at a time only if you’re building native or testing demand on a tighter budget. India-first apps usually launch Android first, iOS 2-4 weeks later.

mainEntity.name: How long does App Store and Play Store review take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Play Store: typically a few hours, sometimes 1-3 days for first submission. App Store: 24-48 hours for most apps, but first submissions are frequently rejected (40-60% rate) and need a re-submit cycle. Plan 1-2 weeks of buffer for store approval in your launch timeline.

mainEntity.name: Is Odoo Community really free forever?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes - Odoo Community is open source under LGPLv3. You pay zero license fees, forever. Your only costs are hosting (if any), implementation help, and any custom development. Odoo SA cannot revoke your right to use Community.

mainEntity.name: Can I use Odoo Community for commercial use?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, including selling Odoo-based services. LGPLv3 explicitly permits commercial use. You only need to share source code of any modifications you distribute (not modifications you keep internal).

mainEntity.name: What is Odoo Studio and is it worth the Enterprise upgrade?

acceptedAnswer.text: Studio is a drag-and-drop interface for adding fields, building reports, and customising views without writing code. For non-technical teams, Studio alone often justifies the Enterprise upgrade because it eliminates 20-30 hours of developer time per quarter on small customisations.

mainEntity.name: Do I need Odoo Enterprise for GST compliance in India?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Both Community and Enterprise support Indian GST via the l10n_in localisation modules. The difference is that Enterprise includes some additional automation (e-invoicing integration, better tax reports). Community works fine for most Indian SMBs.

mainEntity.name: What is the most common cause of Odoo go-live failure?

acceptedAnswer.text: Dirty source data. Duplicate contacts, mismatched UoMs, opening balances that don’t tie to the trial balance - these cascade into reporting issues that erode user trust in the first two weeks. We spend more time on data cleanup than configuration.

mainEntity.name: Can I migrate from Tally to Odoo without losing financial history?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, but selectively. We typically import opening balances (cash, bank, debtors, creditors, stock) as of go-live date and keep Tally read-only for historical lookups. Importing full Tally history into Odoo is technically possible but adds 4-6 weeks and rarely pays off.

mainEntity.name: Do I need to stop business operations during Odoo migration?

acceptedAnswer.text: No - that’s the point of parallel running. Most businesses freeze data entry for 24 hours during cutover (weekend ideal), then run both systems in parallel for 1 week before fully retiring the old system.
